description: Structured dataset of communities, registries, treatment pathways and reference tools for ultra-rare / N-of-1 genetic conditions.

resources.name: r/rarediseases
resources.description: The main rare-disease community on Reddit. Runs recurring 'Diagnostic Odyssey' megathreads for people still seeking a diagnosis.

resources.name: r/biotech
resources.description: Where families often ask about nano-rare treatment options and get pointed toward the right organisations.

resources.name: r/LivingWithHirayama
resources.description: Example of a condition-specific subreddit started by a patient because no community existed for a very rare disease.

resources.name: DNA Unicorn
resources.description: A resource built specifically for the N-of-1 community, including how-to guides for running your own search campaign across social media and registries.

resources.name: NORD (National Organization for Rare Disorders)
resources.description: US umbrella organisation for rare disease; disease reports, advocacy, and patient assistance programmes.

resources.name: EURORDIS
resources.description: European umbrella alliance of rare disease patient organisations.

resources.name: Rare Portal (Australia)
resources.description: Australian rare disease information and support, including guidance for undiagnosed patients.

resources.name: Genetic Alliance UK
resources.description: UK alliance of organisations supporting people affected by genetic conditions.

resources.name: Global Genes
resources.description: Global rare disease advocacy and patient data programmes (parent of RARE-X).

resources.name: Undiagnosed Diseases Network Foundation (UDNF)
resources.description: Patient-led foundation supporting people who remain undiagnosed.

resources.name: MyGene2
resources.description: Patient portal to find others with the same gene or phenotype; feeds into Matchmaker Exchange.

resources.name: Matchmaker Exchange
resources.description: Federated network that lets one query search many rare-disease registries at once.

resources.name: GeneMatcher
resources.description: Researcher-to-researcher service for matching cases by gene.

resources.name: GenomeConnect
resources.description: Share genetic and health results securely and be matched with others.

resources.name: Undiagnosed Diseases Network (UDN)
resources.description: NIH-funded clinical research network for people without a diagnosis; genome sequencing plus expert review.

resources.name: RARE-X
resources.description: Structured, patient-led data collection platform to accelerate rare disease research.

resources.name: n-Lorem Foundation
resources.description: Develops bespoke antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) therapies for nano-rare patients and provides them free for life. Usually requires a physician referral.

resources.name: N=1 Collaborative
resources.description: International hub for individualised medicines; connects the people building N-of-1 therapies.

resources.name: 1 Mutation 1 Medicine (1M1M)
resources.description: European consortium building a best-practice framework for evaluating patients for tailored genomic therapies.

resources.name: Every Cure
resources.description: Nonprofit working to repurpose already-approved drugs for diseases they were not originally developed for.

resources.name: Mila's Miracle Foundation
resources.description: The foundation behind milasen, the first drug custom-made for a single person; advocates for N-of-1 therapy development.

resources.name: Lydian Accelerator
resources.description: Nonprofit building an open platform to make individualised genetic treatments routine.

resources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
resources.description: Registry of clinical studies worldwide; find trials, principal investigators and enrolling sites.

resources.name: Orphanet
resources.description: The reference database on rare diseases, with prevalence and nomenclature.

resources.name: OMIM
resources.description: Catalogue of Mendelian disorders, searchable by symptom or phenotype.

resources.name: GeneReviews
resources.description: Peer-reviewed clinical descriptions of genetic conditions, including management.

resources.name: GARD (Genetic and Rare Diseases Information Center)
resources.description: NIH information centre with plain-language summaries of thousands of rare diseases.

resources.name: PubMed
resources.description: Biomedical literature database; the primary place to read published case reports for an ultra-rare variant.

resources.name: FaceMatch
resources.description: Free tool that attempts to suggest a diagnosis by matching facial features against people who already have a diagnosis.
